faq.question: How much will my project cost, and how long will it take?
faq.answer: The price and timeline depend on the features, integrations, design, and current state of the project. Send me a brief description or specification. I will clarify the details and agree the scope, price, and stages with you before development.

faq.question: Can you continue work on an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. I can review the code and current behavior, fix issues, add features, or connect other services. I first need to understand the technology, available access, and the changes you want, then I can propose the next steps.

faq.question: What do you need to get started?
faq.answer: Describe who the product is for, what it needs to do, and what you already have. A short message, examples, design, or specification can be enough for the first discussion. Contact me on Telegram or by email, and I will clarify any missing details.

faq.question: Can you build a website in several languages?
faq.answer: Yes. I can provide separate pages for each language, a language switcher, and the technical foundation for search indexing. We agree the languages, translations, and review process separately. Multilingual pages do not guarantee search positions.
